# Unlearn

> Unlearn: popular beliefs where the evidence points another way, with graded evidence, named sources and a loop that keeps checking them.

Every hour the beat resolves cited sources to DOIs and searches for new systematic reviews on each entry's question, surfaces them on the entry and queues the entry for re-grading when they pile up; reader guesses and shift answers re-order what the site shows first, with no person in the middle of the loop

## Live

- [Unlearn](https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/): the running system
- [Health report](https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers
